spanish: Y todo utensilio de barro que cayere desde ellos a su medio, todo lo que en su medio se impurecerá, y a él quebrarás.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 2nd person masculine plural is a plural address (ustedes). quebrarás is 2nd person singular, so the number of the addressees changes.

notes: The vessel, the fall from them into its midst, the contents becoming unclean, and the object suffix otherwise match the tokens.
